items.title: Lucky escape as car crashes down pedestrian steps near Louth tourist hotspot
Magic circle: Stonehenge offers lucky visitors 20 minutes alone in monument
items.summary: Handful of ticketholders will be selected at random for up-close visits to ancient site throughout AugustTrips to Stonehenge can be a little hectic. Tens of thousands of people turn up to celebrate summer and winter solstices and most other days the site is a place of bustle, excited conversation and selfie action.But throughout August, English Heritage is offering visitors the chance to win some guaranteed solitude within the hulking stones.

items.title: ‘Farage’s got to come clean or clear off’: what voters on Clacton beach think about their MP – and the country
items.summary: Nigel Farage’s constituency takes in genteel resorts and one of England’s poorest villages. With a snap byelection approaching, what do the residents want from the Reform UK leader – or the bin who’s challenging him?‘If it’s the Tin Man, then I suppose I’ll vote for Nigel,” says a Clacton resident, a retiree on a slow stroll towards the seafront, when I ask whom she will vote for in the forthcoming byelection.
